topics.title: GIF Day Noodle Update
topics.summary: The recent merge of PR #3076 enhances the GIF day noodles feature, extending it from 1 day to 3 days. This change, suggested by @trueberryless, aims to improve user engagement by allowing more time for GIF sharing, thus enriching the overall experience on the platform.

topics.title: Community Engagement on Bluesky
topics.summary: A repost from @matteogabriele.bsky.social emphasizes that @npmx.dev serves as more than just a package browser; it symbolizes a movement towards reclaiming the internet. This highlights the community's desire for empowerment and self-creation in the digital space.

topics.title: User Interaction on Bluesky
topics.summary: A simple yet engaging post on Bluesky featuring a clapping emoji signifies user appreciation and support for @npmx.dev. This interaction reflects the community's positive sentiment and engagement with the platform's initiatives and updates.
